title: IAEA Says Iran Not Cooperating With Nuclear Inspections
description:
The United Nations atomic watchdog says Iran is not cooperating with inspections and says there has been construction activity at Iran's Pickaxe Mountain, a site suspected of housing nuclear-related activities. IAEA Director General Rafael Mariano Grossi shares what they've found on "Bloomberg Surveillance."
